Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The undetected-bicycle rule is printed as a legal defense limited to red-light violations; the dossier keeps that limit and does not present it as a general right to run a red light [A01].
The lane splitting and lane filtering drawings and the commercial vehicle no-zone image were read from their captions only; the distances come from the page text [A04].
The ENS sign is described as carrying a round-the-clock telephone number; the dossier does not print any number because none appears in the text and each crossing has its own sign [A06].
The work zone fine is stated as an add-on to the regular speeding ticket, as printed, and is isolated as a dynamic fact in part C.
The car and tractor-trailer stopping distances are printed as an average and an approximate need; the dossier keeps them as typical figures, not legal limits.
